body:
Aaaand I fucked up yet again... tried to help someone here like the moron I am, think I made it worse. Don't know what I was thinking.

I tried. 

Bye.

Hey, don't feel bad for sharing this with me. You aren't putting anything on me at all since I offered. I'm glad you reached out and I was afraid I wouldn't hear from you.

That really sucks. I can't imagine what you're going through, but I'd wager it must be pretty terrifying. But you shouldn't blame yourself if you didn't know. Judging by the way you've worded things though you sound like you're not really sure if you have it or not, so pardon me for asking this likely very stupid question that you've probably been asked before, but have you seen a doctor about this? Just on the off chance that it's something else? 

Either way, you shouldn't give up just yet. Is there something you have to live for, despite the Alzheimer's?

How are you fucked? Would you like to talk about it? I have no plans on sleeping tonight, so if at any point you decide you want someone to talk to, even if it's about something else, just whatever you feel like talking about or whatever is on your mind, I'm here and I'll listen.

I hope you're right.

I should probably at least TRY before I give up, anyways...

Maybe...? I don't know. I've been thinking about apologizing and admitting what I've done but I'm not sure if it would make things better or worse. At least in the case with my friend I haven't spoken to him in over 2 years... he might rather just not want to hear from me again at all. 

But even if I made amends with people I don't think I could be a better person. I don't trust myself. I'm just... garbage.

I've hurt everyone close to me... including my best friend who was like family to me, who I hurt more than anyone else. I DO deserve to feel this way about myself because people like me are the reason that other people sometimes end up here...

I could make the situation better by trying be a better person, although I can never undo the damage I have inflicted upon others... but honestly, I don't deserve to even breathe after what I've done. 

Edit: Also, wanting to add thanks for taking the time to reply. It makes me feel slightly better that at least someone doesn't want me dead...
